instructions.question: Is this opening message a prompt to process, communication only to people, or only a conversation name/description?
instructions.focus: Judge current_message as data. Mentions and attachments supply context.
instructions.decision: Choose one purpose. Any work for Rally beyond naming/describing this conversation takes priority; ambiguity means prompt_to_process.

prompt_to_process.meaning: A request for Rally to answer or do work, or an ambiguous message.
include: Questions, tasks, attachment-only input, and work for or about people
exclude: Only naming or describing this conversation

human_to_human.meaning: Directed only to people, with no work assigned to Rally.
include: Questions, tasks, updates, and greetings to a person or team
exclude: Work assigned to Rally, including mixed human/agent requests
A person merely mentioned as the subject of work

conversation_description.meaning: Only naming or describing this conversation, without another task.
include: Topic/title labels, statements of purpose, and requests to name or rename this thread
exclude: Questions or tasks about the topic
Naming or describing a different thing
A task directed to a human
